armyRules.name: For the Greater Good
armyRules.effect: At the start of your Shooting phase, select units to become Observer units. Each Observer unit (that hasn't shot yet, isn't a Fortification, and isn't Battle-shocked) marks one visible enemy unit as Spotted until the end of the phase. Other units with this ability targeting Spotted units become Guided units and gain +1 Ballistic Skill (plus [IGNORES COVER] if spotted via a MARKERLIGHT unit).

battleFormations.name: Kauyon
battleFormations.effect: Patient Hunter: During battle rounds 3-5, T'au Empire ranged weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. During rounds 3-5, Guided units attacking Spotted units can ignore modifiers to Ballistic Skill and to the Hit roll.

battleFormations.name: Mont'ka
battleFormations.effect: Killing Blow: During battle rounds 1-3, T'au Empire ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT]. During rounds 1-3, Guided units' ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS].

battleFormations.name: Retaliation Cadre
battleFormations.effect: Bonded Heroes: T'au Empire BATTLESUIT ranged attacks against targets within 12" gain +1 Strength; against targets within 8" also gain +1 AP. Unique: BATTLESUIT.

battleFormations.name: Kroot Hunting Pack
battleFormations.effect: Hunter's Instincts: Kroot attacks against below-strength targets gain +1 Hit (+1 Wound also if Below Half-strength). Skirmish Fighters: Kroot models gain a 6+ invulnerable save vs melee and 5+ vs ranged. KROOT CARNIVORE units gain BATTLELINE.

battleFormations.name: Advanced Acquisition Cadre
battleFormations.effect: Expert Fieldcraft: PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS units that shoot do not lose the 'hidden' state.

battleFormations.name: Auxiliary Cadre
battleFormations.effect: Integrated Command Structure: Friendly KROOT/VESPID STINGWINGS units gain a Harnessed Aggression-type ability (text partial — verify remainder on Wahapedia).

battleFormations.name: Experimental Prototype Cadre
battleFormations.effect: Superior Craftsmanship: (Detachment rule text not captured this pass — verify on Wahapedia.)

artefacts.name: Exemplar of the Kauyon
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE model only (excl. KROOT SHAPER)] While leading a unit, the Patient Hunter rule applies to that unit from round 2 instead of round 3.

artefacts.name: Precision of the Patient Hunter
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE model only] +1 to Hit roll on ranged attacks; from round 3 onward also +1 to Wound roll.

artefacts.name: Solid-image Projection Unit
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE model only] After deployment, redeploy up to 3 units, any to Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: Through Unity, Devastation
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE model only (excl. KROOT SHAPER)] While leading an Observer unit, Guided units targeting the Spotted unit gain [LETHAL HITS].

artefacts.name: Coordinated Exploitation
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE model only (excl. KROOT SHAPER)] While leading an Observer unit, Guided units targeting the Spotted unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

artefacts.name: Exemplar of the Mont'ka
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE model only (excl. KROOT SHAPER)] The Killing Blow rule applies to the led unit during round 4 as well.

artefacts.name: Strategic Conqueror
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE model only] Select an objective at battle start; while the bearer is on the battlefield and near it, +1 Objective Control to friendly models there.

artefacts.name: Strike Swiftly
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE model only] Grant Scouts 6" to up to two nearby units at battle start.

artefacts.name: Internal Grenade Racks
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only] Gains GRENADES keyword; can inflict mortal wounds on units moved over.

artefacts.name: Prototype Weapon System
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only] Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] for the bearer's ranged weapons each time it shoots.

artefacts.name: Puretide Engram Neurochip
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only] Each time the bearer's unit is targeted by a Stratagem, on a 4+ gain 1CP.

artefacts.name: Starflare Ignition System
artefacts.effect: [T'AU EMPIRE BATTLESUIT model only] If unengaged at end of opponent's turn, retreat to Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: Borthrod Gland
artefacts.effect: [Kroot Flesh Shaper only] While leading a unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ in melee scores a Critical Hit.

artefacts.name: Kroothawk Flock
artefacts.effect: [KROOT model only] Ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER]; enemy Reinforcements cannot set up within 12" of the bearer.

artefacts.name: Nomadic Hunter
artefacts.effect: [KROOT TRAIL SHAPER model only] While leading a unit, +3" Move and ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT].

artefacts.name: Root-carved Weapons
artefacts.effect: [Kroot War Shaper model only] All weapons gain [PRECISION] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

artefacts.name: Unmasking Suite
artefacts.effect: [GHOSTKEEL BATTLESUIT/PATHFINDER TEAM/STEALTH BATTLESUITS unit only] Select an enemy unit within 24"; it gains +9" detection range until this unit shoots.
